rules.description: AttackBox request, response, transcript and probe evidence; trusted shipper envelope
rules.nrql: sensor_id = 'srv-000000' AND `service.name` = 'attackbox' AND source = 'bait' AND stream IN ('edge', 'transcript', 'probe')

rules.description: AttackBox runtime and egress evidence plus native Linux audit records
rules.nrql: sensor_id = 'srv-000000' AND ((`service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream IN ('runtime', 'egress')) OR logtype = 'linux_audit')

rules.description: AttackBox producer heartbeats and native host operational files
rules.nrql: sensor_id = 'srv-000000' AND ((`service.name` = 'attackbox' AND stream = 'heartbeat') OR (collection_route = 'native-infrastructure' AND (logtype IS NULL OR logtype != 'linux_audit')))
